We’re looking for a bilingual Recruiter / Trainer who loves moving fast, knows their numbers, and takes pride in building a team that shows up and stays. We provide a steady pipeline of applicants. Your job is to turn them into trained, compliant, reliable cleaners who deliver our standard from their very first job. You’ll report directly to our General Manager. Schedule • Tuesday to Saturday, 8 AM to 4 PM Mountain Time, with Sunday and Monday off. What you’ll do • Get up to speed fast. Complete our full recruiter training within your first 24 hours on the job. • Work the pipeline. Contact every new applicant within 24 hours, screen candidates by phone and video in English and Spanish, and focus on the markets and shifts where we need coverage most. • Onboard with zero gaps. Make sure every new cleaner completes their contract, insurance verification, W-9 and payroll setup before their first job, which can be as soon as the day after they’re hired. • Train for quality. Teach new cleaners our standards, checklists and service levels, including heavy duty and deep cleans, plus how to use our booking and communication tools. Retrain cleaners when quality slips. • Keep every market covered. Work with our Operations team to fill weekly staffing needs by city, day and shift. • Own your numbers. Track your KPIs daily, close out your priorities every day, and send a clear end-of-day update on what’s done and what’s pending. • Make the department better. Bring ideas on how we screen, onboard, train and keep cleaners, and help turn them into processes that stick. How you’ll be measured • Coverage. Every market has enough active cleaners to handle its jobs, and the weekly staffing needs from Operations get filled fast. • Pipeline. You know your numbers every week by market: applicants, interviews, hires and how many applicants become cleaners. • Speed. Every applicant hears from you within 24 hours, and good candidates move from application to signed contract in days, not weeks. • Ready to work. Every new cleaner is fully onboarded and trained before their first job, which can be the day after they’re hired. 100%, no exceptions. • Hiring the right people. The cleaners you hire show up on time, do great work from their first job, and stay with us at 30, 60 and 90 days. • Compliance. Cleaner files stay current, with no expired insurance and no missing documents. Must haves • Available Tuesday to Saturday, 8 AM to 4 PM Mountain Time, every week • Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken • 2+ years in recruiting or screening, including high-volume hiring of hourly workers or independent contractors • Experience training or onboarding new hires on service standards or procedures • Experience creating an onboarding or training program on your own, from scratch to launch • Experience with onboarding paperwork such as contracts, W-9s or insurance verification • Experience hiring for more than one city or market at the same time • Experience with a booking platform or applicant tracking system • Strong knowledge of AI tools and hands-on experience implementing them in real workflows • Experience being measured on hiring KPIs such as time to hire or retention • Able to complete a full training program within your first 24 hours on the job • Comfortable working toward daily KPI targets and sending daily reports • A reliable computer and high-speed internet connection for remote work Nice to have • Home services experience, such as cleaning or maid services • A track record of suggesting and implementing process improvements • Experience with BookingKoala • Experience recruiting independent contractors across different US states • Experience with QuickBooks or contractor payroll setup • Experience with automation tools such as Zapier • Advanced Google Sheets skills, such as formulas, tracking sheets and simple dashboards • Experience with a cloud phone system such as Quo • Experience writing job ads and recruiting posts that attract strong applicants • Experience creating training materials in both English and Spanish • Experience working with a fully remote team across time zones Who thrives here • Fast, consistent follow-up. No applicant goes uncontacted. • Organized with paperwork and compliance. Nothing slips through. • Always looking for a better way, and brings ideas instead of waiting to be told Why join us You’ll have real ownership of a department that directly drives our growth, a direct line to leadership, and the freedom to improve how things are done. If you like clear goals, fast decisions and seeing your work show up in the numbers, you’ll fit right in.
